(define (d2-tokenizer-identity tokenizer)
  ;; T2 accessors intentionally name their own operations.  D2 remaps a forged
  ;; or wrong-aggregate tokenizer at its public boundary without leaking those
  ;; lower-layer operation names.
  (guard
   (caught
    ((transformer-error? caught)
     (d2-fail 'invalid-argument 'token-dataset-open
              "expected a same-aggregate tokenizer"))
    (else (raise caught)))
   (vector (t2-private-tokenizer-fingerprint tokenizer)
           (t2-private-tokenizer-vocab-size tokenizer))))
